fields.fuels: Annual grass, chaparral and oak woodland
fields.evacuations: Zones C-1 to C-3 ordered (1,370 residents); Zones C-4 and C-5 warned (2,300 residents).

projectedActivity.activity: Continued wind-driven spread to the southwest; spotting to a half mile.
Wind falls after 9 PM; growth slows on the west flank.
Northeast wind returns in the afternoon.

fields.criticalNeeds: 1. Two strike teams of engines. 2. One heavy air tanker. 3. Night operations helicopter.
fields.weatherConcerns: Northeast gusts to 35 mph until 9 PM; humidity 9 to 12 percent; a red flag warning is in effect until 6 AM.
fields.resources: 38 engines, 6 hand crews, 4 dozers, 3 helicopters, 312 personnel.
fields.remarks: Cooperating: county sheriff, state forestry, the utility's liaison.
